asset: Psychometric Assessment Types and How to Judge Their Validity
distinct_angle: Where their page namedrops validity, reliability, and norming without defining any of them or naming a single concrete test type, ours defines each term in plain language, gives a worked example of a validity check, and breaks down the real categories of psychometric tests (cognitive, personality, situational judgment, aptitude) recruiters actually choose between.
